title: Hours-of-Service of Drivers: Proposed Flexibility for Commercial Motor Carriers
summary: The FMCSA proposes adjustments to the maximum driving and on-duty limits and rest-break provisions for drivers operating commercial motor vehicles in interstate trucking. The proposal affects motor carriers and their drivers only.
full_text: The Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration proposes amendments to the hours-of-service regulations that govern the maximum driving time and on-duty periods for drivers of commercial motor vehicles operated by motor carriers in interstate commerce. The proposal would modify the rest-break requirement and the sleeper-berth provision for long-haul drivers. These requirements apply to commercial motor carriers and the drivers they employ.
